name: ON.energy
mood: high-voltage caution yellow on midnight steel
summary: A flat industrial-signage style with black, caution yellow, and industrial white full-bleed sections, Univers Next Pro 300/400 typography only, tight tracking, small utilitarian radii, shadowless surfaces, and dark hardware photography.

typography.fallback: Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk, Helvetica Neue

layout.model: full-bleed section modes, no global max-width for major color sections

dos: Use weight 300 for all headlines and display text.
Use weight 400 for body and UI.
Use Caution Yellow only for CTA buttons, full yellow sections, and small accents.
Alternate full-bleed dark image, yellow, and industrial white sections.
Keep functional radii small and utilitarian.
donts: Do not use type weights 500, 600, or 700.
Do not use yellow body text on yellow backgrounds.
Do not use large radii on functional elements.
Do not constrain full-bleed sections to a global max-width container.
